newsitem.title: JAPAN: GOLF-MESHIAI WINS JAPAN MATCHPLAY CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MESHIAI WINS JAPAN MATCHPLAY CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Hajime Meshiai beat Kazuhiko Hosokawa by one hole to win the Japan Championship matchplay tournament on Sunday and qualify for the Andersen Consulting World Championship of Golf final in Arizona next January.

Meshiai went two up over the first nine holes but Hosokawa drew level after the turn. But on the par five 18th Meshiai put his third shot about one yard from the pin and easily tapped in the birdie for the win.
Meshiai, the Japan PGA tour's leading money winner in 1993, earlier defeated Toru Suzuki 3 and 1 in the semifinal on the 6,970-yard course at the Golden Palm Country Club.
"He won because of his technique, not his strength. I hope he can show that again in Arizona," Suzuki said.
